cerruti_kernel — DRIVE tacslip op

• Data kinds: scalar × scalar × scalar × scalar → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.cerruti_kernel(n: 'int', pitch: 'float', G: 'float', nu: 'float', sub: 'int' = 4, with_uz: 'bool' = False) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import tacslip; tacslip.cerruti_kernel(n: 'int', pitch: 'float', G: 'float', nu: 'float', sub: 'int' = 4, with_uz: 'bool' = False) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("cerruti_kernel"))

Usage

Builds the discrete kernel of the surface displacement produced by an x-directed tangential traction (uniform 1 Pa over 1 pixel = pitch²) on a 2n grid (for zero-padded linear convolution) and returns it already rfft2-transformed.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

核は画素ごとに画素平均で持つ(sub×sub の副標本の平均)。中心画素は 1/r が可積分なので解析値 —— ∫□ 1/r dA = 4h ln(1+√2)、∫□ x²/r³ dA = 2h ln(1+√2)(対称性から ∫x²/r³ = ∫y²/r³ = ½∫1/r)、∫□ xy/r³ = ∫□ x/r² = 0。返り: Kxx・Kyx(接線 → 接線)、with_uz=True なら Kzx(接線 → 法線、係数 (1−2ν) で ν 0.48 では 0.04 倍)、n・pitch・G・nu。閉形式 (3.91) との一致は ūx 0.017 %・ūy 0.03 %(256 px、PoC の門)。Raises ValueError: n < 8、pitch, G ≤ 0、sub < 1。
